objects.name: Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data
objects.description: The RovoBlast attack method identified by Varonis researchers could have been exploited to steal Confluence, Jira and SharePoint data. The post Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data appeared first on SecurityWeek .
